title: Relationship Courtesy on ClearPath Late Fees
content:
**Courtesy.** The relationship courtesy on the late fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services invoice reads the client's other managed services:
- an active Sentinel Managed Security subscription together with an active Continuum Backup & Recovery plan takes 20.0 percent off;
- exactly one of the two takes 10.0 percent off;
- neither takes nothing off.

| Active Sentinel Managed Security subscription | Active Continuum Backup & Recovery plan | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 20.0 percent off |
| yes | no | 10.0 percent off |
| no | yes | 10.0 percent off |
| no | no | nothing |

Only the status of the client's Sentinel subscription and Continuum plan counts here: active or not.
